title: Reliability concerns with account connections
text:
My experience with Empower has been disappointing due to recurring account connection issues that affected my ability to rely on the app.

Despite attempts to resolve the problems, they remained unresolved. Reliable account connections are essential for a financial tracking app, and these issues made it difficult for me to continue using the service with confidence.

I’ve decided to switch to another app and discontinue using Empower. I understand that experiences vary, and it may work well for others, but I’d encourage potential users to make sure the account connections remain reliable before committing to it as their primary financial tracking tool.
